csv_project_name: A/E For Next-Gen Climbing Range & Substation Technology
csv_scope_of_work: Alpena Community College (ACC) is seeking proposals from qualified Architectural & Engineering (A/E) firms to provide comprehensive design and construction administration services for the NextGen Climbing Range and Substation Technology Project located on ACC property, north of main campus on Woodward Avenue, adjacent to the south of the Farming the Sun solar array, in Alpena, Michigan. The project includes: Building construction Steel towers and steel utility poles (approximately 110 tall) that create an approximately 1800 linear feet of aerial training grounds Electrical substation training components Site engineering and development (roads, grading, crushed limestone, fencing) Integration with adjacent solar array infrastructure
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
